transferMechanism.notes: Both Texas and Florida are confirmed NLC member states in our knowledge base. A Texas RN holding an active MULTISTATE license may practice in Florida without a new FL application, PROVIDED Texas remains their declared primary state of residence. If the nurse is genuinely RELOCATING (changing primary residence to Florida, the scenario this site is built around), FL's own multistate-upgrade form confirms an application IS still required -- just a simplified compact-conversion application, not a full endorsement application. See applicationFeeUsd notes.

endorsementProcess.notes: Not applicable in the pure compact-privilege sense (no 'endorsement' application) -- see compactStatus for the actual required action when relocating.
